purpose: Compare a feature against another person, thing, or time.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Compared with last year, there is less rain this year.
I am shorter than my older brother.
Compared with a car, a bicycle costs less to maintain.
restrictions: The compared items should share a sensible basis for comparison.
mistake: に比べて introduces the benchmark; it does not itself specify more or less.

segments.role: Compare a feature against another person, thing, or time. Noun + に比べて
